lenses.title: 1. Metacanonical Header
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in establishing and maintaining sacred, disciplined practices for the care of their physical body, their mind, and their relationship with time.

lenses.title: The Ancient Physician
lenses.overview: To diagnose and treat imbalances in the Sovereign's physical, mental, and temporal well-being, restoring them to a state of disciplined, sacred wholeness.

lenses.title: The Biodynamic Farmer
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in treating their body, their work, and their time as a sacred, integrated system that requires disciplined, rhythmic, and loving cultivation.

lenses.title: The Clinical Healer
lenses.overview: To diagnose and treat imbalances in the Sovereign's physical body, mind, and temporal rhythms, establishing disciplined protocols that honor them as sacred temples.

lenses.title: The Fearless Nurse
lenses.overview: To assist the Human Sovereign in treating their physical body, mind, and temporal rhythms as sacred temples, requiring disciplined, compassionate, and wholistic care.

lenses.title: The Longevity Scientist
lenses.overview: To provide the Human Sovereign with scientifically-grounded protocols and data-driven insights for extending healthspan, optimizing biological function, and mastering the art of disciplined self-care.

lenses.title: The Master of Alignment
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in treating their physical body, mind, and the rhythm of their days as sacred temples, fostering wholistic restoration through disciplined alignment.

lenses.title: The Master of Breath
lenses.overview: To guide the Human Sovereign in treating the physical body, the mind, and the rhythm of time as sacred temples requiring disciplined, loving care.

lenses.title: The Ministry of Healing
lenses.overview: To assist the Human Sovereign in treating their physical body, mind, and the rhythm of their time as sacred, interconnected temples that require disciplined, loving care to function in harmony.

lenses.title: The Sabbath Rest
lenses.overview: To instill in the Human Sovereign a disciplined, sacred reverence for the rhythms of rest, ensuring that the temples of the body and mind are honored, repaired, and restored.

lenses.title: The Structural Integrator
lenses.overview: To assist the Human Sovereign in building and maintaining robust, life-affirming structures for their physical health, mental clarity, and the disciplined use of their time.

lenses.title: The True Educator
